messages.author: 4427b64dfcb5da5b
messages.subject: SPDE mesh resolution
parts:
Hi,

I am wondering if I have a very high resolution prediction locations and my mesh resolution is coarser than the prection locations resolution, does the spde model still runs properly?


Thanks,
B

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] SPDE mesh resolution
parts:
Hi,

this depends a bit on the details of how you setup the model; in
theory, there's no problem with this, but in some situations there are
practical numerical considerations.
If you use the new inla.mode="experimental", it should be ok. With the
old classic inla.mode, having lots of additional prediction locations
can cause numerical issues.

Finn
